en-US.whatsNew:
Six editions of the Pāḷi canon in one app — including Mahāsaṅgīti, Sri Lankan (BJT), Burmese, Thai and PTS — side by side in columns, with the differences between them marked. Nowhere else can you read and compare them like this.

Offline, piece by piece — choose which canons and translations to keep on your device and download only those. Search and reading then work with no connection.

Also: pinch to change the text size anywhere, a faster built-in dictionary, copying a line gives it from every edition with its name, iPad layout fixes.
